create_fixed_steps_environment: create a FixedNumberOfStepsEnvironment that terminates after a fixed number of steps with step count as reward
wrap_environment_with_onehot_observation: wrap a base environment with OneHotObservationsFromDiscrete to convert discrete observations into one-hot encoded tensors
flatten_dict_observations: wrap an environment with FlattenDictObservations to convert dictionary observations into a single flattened 1-D tensor
build_observation_adapter: build a custom observation transformation adapter by subclassing ObservationTransformationEnvironmentAdapterBase and implementing compute_tensor_observation
review_environment_step_and_reset: review the Environment step and reset methods to understand how actions produce results and how environments are initialized
